Summary: Phase 01: Create the project Git repository
Description: Set up version control for the music library project.

Summary: Phase 01: Set up the Python environment
Description: Create and document a Python virtual environment for the project.

Summary: Phase 01: Recursively scan the music library
Description: Scan the main music folder and its YYYYMMDD subfolders for MP3 files.

Summary: Phase 01: Read MP3 metadata with Mutagen
Description: Read metadata using Mutagen EasyID3. Capture artist, album, track title, track number, year, genre, album artist, label when available, and embedded artwork.

Summary: Phase 01: Store scanned paths and metadata
Description: Store each source file path together with its extracted metadata.

Summary: Phase 01: Identify incomplete metadata
Description: Detect missing or incomplete tags in scanned files.

Summary: Phase 01: Report files with missing metadata
Description: Produce a report identifying files whose metadata is missing or incomplete.

Summary: Phase 01: Keep scanning read-only initially
Description: Ensure the initial scanner never modifies music files automatically.

Summary: Phase 02: Use SQLite for the initial music database
Description: Set up SQLite as the initial persistence layer for the scanned music library.

Summary: Phase 02: Import the scanned music library
Description: Load scanned file metadata into the SQLite database.

Summary: Phase 02: Model albums and releases
Description: Represent albums as works/releases rather than treating every track as a separate album; support LPs and EPs.

Summary: Phase 02: Link albums to artists
Description: Create and maintain album-to-artist relationships.

Summary: Phase 02: Link albums to labels and genres
Description: Create and maintain album relationships to record labels and genres.

Summary: Phase 02: Link albums to tracks
Description: Create and maintain album track listings and their relationships.

Summary: Phase 02: Preserve original file paths
Description: Keep the original path for each imported music file.

Summary: Phase 02: Record metadata scan and enrichment dates
Description: Record when metadata was last scanned or enriched.

Summary: Phase 02: Make imports repeatable
Description: Make repeated imports safe and avoid creating duplicate data.

Summary: Phase 03: Define required metadata fields
Description: Decide which metadata fields are mandatory for library records.

Summary: Phase 03: Detect duplicate albums and tracks
Description: Identify duplicate album and track records.

Summary: Phase 03: Detect inconsistent artist and album names
Description: Identify inconsistent naming for artists and albums.

Summary: Phase 03: Find albums missing artwork
Description: Identify albums that do not have artwork.

Summary: Phase 03: Find albums missing year, genre, or label
Description: Identify albums missing a release year, genre, or label.

Summary: Phase 03: Generate metadata cleanup reports
Description: Generate reports of metadata issues before making any changes.

Summary: Phase 03: Add optional automatic tag fixing
Description: Eventually support optional automatic tag fixing; keep it disabled unless explicitly requested.

Summary: Phase 04: Investigate MusicBrainz
Description: Evaluate MusicBrainz as a source of structured music metadata.

Summary: Phase 04: Investigate Discogs and other data sources
Description: Evaluate Discogs and other useful sources for music metadata enrichment.

Summary: Phase 04: Match albums and artists despite spelling differences
Description: Match external records to library albums and artists when names differ in spelling or formatting.

Summary: Phase 04: Enrich missing music metadata
Description: Enrich missing release date or year, country, label, genre or style, artist information, band members, instruments, lineup changes, and related releases.

Summary: Phase 04: Track metadata provenance
Description: Record the source of each enriched piece of information.

Summary: Phase 04: Record enrichment confidence
Description: Record match and confidence information for enrichment results.

Summary: Phase 04: Protect existing metadata during enrichment
Description: Do not blindly overwrite existing information; make enrichment optional and repeatable.

Summary: Phase 05: Collect magazine PDFs
Description: Collect and organize the previous magazine PDFs.

Summary: Phase 05: Process magazines issue by issue
Description: Process the magazine archive one issue at a time.

Summary: Phase 05: Extract text from magazine PDFs
Description: Extract text from text-based PDF pages.

Summary: Phase 05: OCR scanned magazine pages
Description: Use OCR for scanned or image-only pages.

Summary: Phase 05: Preserve extracted source text
Description: Keep the original extracted text for reference and reprocessing.

Summary: Phase 05: Identify and classify magazine articles
Description: Identify articles and classify them as album reviews, interviews, news, or other.

Summary: Phase 05: Store issue and page references
Description: Store magazine issue date or number and page information.

Summary: Phase 06: Detect album reviews
Description: Detect individual album reviews in the processed magazine content.

Summary: Phase 06: Extract review details
Description: Extract artist, album, reviewer, rating, review text, issue, and publication date from each review.

Summary: Phase 06: Link reviews to music library records
Description: Link extracted reviews to matching albums, artists, genres, and labels in the music database.

Summary: Phase 06: Identify unresolved review matches
Description: Identify reviews that could not be matched automatically.

Summary: Phase 06: Support manual review matching
Description: Provide a way to manually correct review-to-library matches.

Summary: Phase 07: Analyze review text with an LLM
Description: Use an LLM to analyze extracted review text.

Summary: Phase 07: Extract review keywords and themes
Description: Extract keywords and themes from reviews.

Summary: Phase 07: Identify musical characteristics and descriptions
Description: Identify musical characteristics and recurring descriptions in reviews.

Summary: Phase 07: Analyze review sentiment and opinion
Description: Analyze the sentiment or opinion expressed in review text.

Summary: Phase 07: Preserve review text alongside analysis
Description: Keep the original review text with all AI-generated analysis.

Summary: Phase 07: Make review analysis reproducible
Description: Make AI analysis reproducible and safe to rerun.

Summary: Phase 07: Support flexible AI analysis fields
Description: Avoid restricting the database to only predefined AI analysis fields.

Summary: Phase 08: Detect interviews in magazine PDFs
Description: Detect interviews in the processed magazine archive.

Summary: Phase 08: Extract interview details and dialogue
Description: Extract artist, interviewer, issue, date, questions, and answers; separate questions from answers.

Summary: Phase 08: Analyze recurring interview questions
Description: Analyze recurring interview questions and find the most frequently asked questions.

Summary: Phase 08: Group similarly worded interview questions
Description: Group questions with similar meaning even when their wording differs.

Summary: Phase 08: Identify recurring interview themes
Description: Identify themes that recur across interviews.

Summary: Phase 08: Explore further interview analysis
Description: Experiment with other useful LLM analysis while keeping this area exploratory and avoiding over-engineering.

Summary: Phase 09: Analyze reviewed and unreviewed artists and albums
Description: Find artists reviewed by the magazine, artists never reviewed, albums never reviewed, and interviewed artists who were never reviewed.

Summary: Phase 09: Analyze label coverage
Description: Find labels covered by the magazine and determine which labels have the most reviews.

Summary: Phase 09: Analyze geographic representation
Description: Find the countries and regions represented in the archive.

Summary: Phase 09: Analyze reviewer activity
Description: Identify the most prolific reviewers.

Summary: Phase 09: Analyze reviews by year and genre
Description: Report reviews per year and albums or reviews by genre.

Summary: Phase 09: Analyze genre changes over time
Description: Analyze how genres changed over time and which genres were reviewed most or least.

Summary: Phase 09: Compare received releases with reviewed releases
Description: Compare releases received with releases actually reviewed.

Summary: Phase 09: Identify archive coverage gaps
Description: Find gaps in the magazine archive and its coverage.

Summary: Phase 10: Find older unreviewed albums
Description: Find albums from previous years that were never reviewed, including albums 5, 10, or 15+ years old.

Summary: Phase 10: Filter rediscovery candidates
Description: Filter older unreviewed albums by genre, label, year, and other useful criteria.

Summary: Phase 10: Create a rediscovery shortlist
Description: Create a shortlist of interesting forgotten albums.

Summary: Phase 10: Explore an Album Never Reviewed feature
Description: Consider using rediscovery candidates for a recurring Album Never Reviewed feature.

Summary: Phase 10: Keep rediscoveries as an optional feature
Description: Keep rediscoveries separate from the core system.

Summary: Phase 11: Learn Django through the project
Description: Use the project as a way to learn Django while building the music library interface.

Summary: Phase 11: Create the Django application and connect SQLite
Description: Create a basic Django application and connect it to the SQLite music database.

Summary: Phase 11: Build an album browser
Description: Create an album browser that displays artwork, artist, album, year, genre, label, and track listing.

Summary: Phase 11: Add search and filtering
Description: Add search and filters for genre, year, artist, label, reviewer, and review status.

Summary: Phase 11: Create artist and album pages
Description: Create detail pages for artists and albums.

Summary: Phase 11: Show magazine reviews on album pages
Description: Display the associated magazine review directly on the album page.

Summary: Phase 11: Show artist interviews
Description: Show interviews associated with each artist.

Summary: Phase 11: Show related albums
Description: Display related albums where useful.

Summary: Phase 12: Add MP3 playback to Django
Description: Add MP3 playback to the Django interface and allow playback of an album from its album page.

Summary: Phase 12: Add player controls
Description: Implement play, pause, seek, and volume controls.

Summary: Phase 12: Add track selection and queue
Description: Support track selection and a playback queue.

Summary: Phase 12: Remember the playback queue
Description: Persist or restore the current queue between visits or sessions.

Summary: Phase 12: Keep the player simple and offline-oriented
Description: Keep playback simple and suitable for offline use; do not attempt to recreate Spotify.

Summary: Phase 13: Visualize reviews by year, genre, and writer
Description: Create visualizations of reviews by year, genre, and writer.

Summary: Phase 13: Visualize artist and label coverage over time
Description: Show artists and labels reviewed over time.

Summary: Phase 13: Visualize genre evolution
Description: Visualize genre evolution and genre review coverage over the years.

Summary: Phase 13: Highlight review and archive leaders
Description: Show the most reviewed artists and labels and the most prolific writers.

Summary: Phase 13: Surface unreviewed artists and albums
Description: Highlight albums and artists with no review.

Summary: Phase 13: Add interactive charts where useful
Description: Use interactive charts where they improve exploration.

Summary: Phase 14: Add semantic search for reviews and interviews
Description: Search reviews and interviews by meaning rather than exact words.

Summary: Phase 14: Support natural-language music discovery queries
Description: Support queries such as finding reviews that describe dark atmospheric black metal.

Summary: Phase 14: Explore unanticipated archive questions
Description: Experiment with questions that were not anticipated when designing the database.

Summary: Phase 14: Adopt embeddings only when needed
Description: Consider embeddings or vector search only when ordinary database search becomes insufficient.

Summary: Phase 15: Make the music scanner runnable on new files
Description: Make the music scanner runnable whenever new files arrive.

Summary: Phase 15: Detect new albums automatically
Description: Automatically detect newly added albums.

Summary: Phase 15: Detect missing metadata automatically
Description: Automatically detect missing metadata in new or changed files.

Summary: Phase 15: Enrich only new or changed albums
Description: Run external metadata enrichment only for new or changed albums.

Summary: Phase 15: Process new magazine PDFs automatically
Description: Automatically process newly added magazine PDFs.

Summary: Phase 15: Detect new reviews and interviews
Description: Automatically detect new reviews and interviews in processed content.

Summary: Phase 15: Queue AI analysis for new content
Description: Queue AI analysis for newly extracted content.

Summary: Phase 15: Keep automation incremental
Description: Process only new or changed data instead of repeatedly rescanning hundreds of gigabytes.

Summary: MVP: Deliver a searchable music library
Description: Start small. Use Python, Mutagen, SQLite, and Django to scan the music folder and build the initial searchable music database and album browser.

Summary: MVP: Build the first album browsing experience
Description: Deliver basic search, an album page, artwork, a track listing, and review status before expanding into later roadmap phases.

Summary: MVP: Import a small magazine sample and link reviews
Description: After the basic browser, import one or two magazine PDFs, extract reviews, and link them to albums.
